content.comment_body: I need to add a button in my diagram that can pause a counter (off-delay). The counter should stop at its current value when the button is pressed, and when the button is pressed again, it should continue counting from where it left off until reaching the programmed end time.
With the standard timers in [product_name], this functionality is not directly available. However, you could use a V/R counter and decrement it with a pulse every second until it reaches zero.
Consider if this approach can help you develop your own solution. [IMAGE] Greetings.

analysis.insight_summary: The user wants to create a control diagram featuring an off-delay timer with a pause/resume option. Standard timers in [product_name] do not natively allow pausing. Community members highlight these limits and propose alternative methods using counters and pulses, though no simple built-in feature exists for this requirement.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates the product will offer an easy way to pause and resume a timer or counter, enabling countdown to continue seamlessly from the paused state.
